brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Cordura / X50 nylon (matte woven, splatter-dye prints)'. The maker's own SPECS tabs (read via a real Chrome session — wizard.works sits behind a Cloudflare JS challenge that 403s curl and WebFetch; the challenge auto-clears in ~7s in an actual browser tab) consistently list '500D Cordura Nylon Outer' in Black/Olive/Tan and '1000D Cordura Polyester Outer' in the Splatter colourway, with a 210D nylon liner. That confirms the Cordura half of the brand string across every product checked so far. No product page mentions 'X50' by name — that may be a liner or reinforcement fabric not called out on the consumer-facing SPECS tab, or a holdover from an older material. Verdict: Cordura is confirmed verbatim per-product; X50 is unconfirmed (neither contradicted nor found) and should be treated as unverified rather than wrong.
brand_notes.method: No usable local photos exist in assets/products/wizard-works/ (only two unrelated placeholder images, t2.jpg and test1.jpg, for 27 products) — see HANDOVER.md. Every record below is built from the maker's own product page (DESCRIPTION + SPECS + FEATURES tabs), fetched in a live Chrome tab (mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate + get_page_text) after the Cloudflare challenge clears. Plain curl and WebFetch both 403. Geometry/hardware fields are therefore page-derived text evidence, not photo-verified, and are marked accordingly in confidence/dims_note. Dimensions quoted in each product's SPECS table are maker-published figures (verified: true); anything inferred beyond the literal page text is flagged low/medium confidence.

products.name: Lil Presto Barrel Bag
products.dims_raw: SPECS tab: Small — Volume 1.8L, Size '20cm Wide x 10.5cm Diameter', Weight 140g (excl straps)
products.dims_note: Hard-shell barrel, no roll axis, so the published size is the mounted size — no unfurled/min-height rule needed. Maker gives length ('Wide') and diameter only; wid/hgt both set to the diameter since the cross-section is round. Page-derived, no photo to confirm proportions.

geometry.notes: Hard-shell construction per maker copy ('the hard-shell design allows for one handed on the bike access and exceptional stability'); two recycled-HDPE-style stiffened panels are typical of this line but not confirmed for this SKU specifically. No photo evidence — shape read from description only, not verified against an image.

closure.hardware: YKK Aquaguard water-resistant zip around a hard-shell lid, one-handed pull

details.notes: Top loops for an optional shoulder strap (sold separately). Includes 2x omni-tape (hook-and-loop) straps and 1x cordlock strap per the Installation section; the cordlock strap is a cinch cord, not modelled as a rigid strap above.

mount.notes: Maker copy: 'mounts to either handlebars or saddles (with saddle loops, i.e. Brooks)' — modelled here in its primary handlebar-mount orientation, dual-mount capability not otherwise geometry-relevant. Clearance not established — no photo to measure against.

products.name: Voila Stem Bag
products.dims_raw: SPECS tab: Medium — Volume 0.9L, Size '15cm Tall x 8cm Diameter', Weight 90g
products.dims_note: Upright cylindrical stem bag: maker's 'Tall' figure is the vertical mounted axis (hgt in this record's own-body convention is 'top to bottom' — mapped to len here since a stem bag's longest run is vertical along its own body; wid/hgt both set to the diameter for the round cross-section). No roll axis, fixed hard-liner shape.

geometry.notes: Maker copy: 'Built with high density foam padding... Constructed with a floating liner to facilitate easy crumb removal' — a semi-rigid, upright cylinder that holds its shape open, not a soft roll-top. No photo evidence for this brand; shape read from description only.

products.name: Go-Go Top Tube Bag
products.dims_raw: SPECS tab: Small — Volume 0.8L, Size '21w x 7d x 8h cm', Weight 110g

geometry.notes: Maker copy: 'Two recycled HDPE inserts give Go-Go its super sharp shape and make it a breeze to open and close with one hand' — a stiff wedge-panel sitting flat on the top tube, tapering toward the head tube per the fuel-tank silhouette described.
